stand.body: All four feet bearing weight, legs roughly vertical, back level, head at or just above the back line

stand_stacked.body: Forelegs vertical, hind legs set back so the hocks are vertical, head up, weight even; held still for inspection

stand_forward.body: Weight shifted over the forelegs, neck raised, ears and tail up, body still and tall

stand_back.body: Weight shifted over the hind legs, head low or turned away, ready to retreat

stand_braced.body: Forelegs planted ahead of the body, weight pulled back against the collar or harness, head low

stand_freeze.body: Sudden total stillness mid-stance, body rigid, mouth closed, often a fixed stare; comes right before escalating or fleeing

stand_point.body: Frozen with head, spine and tail aligned toward a scent or target, often one foreleg lifted and folded; held until released

stand_paw_lift.body: Standing on three legs with one foreleg flexed and held up, not aimed at anything

stand_cower.body: Legs flexed and body lowered, back rounded, tail tucked, ears back, head low

stand_over.body: Standing over another dog with head or chest across its shoulders, body stiff, forming a T

stand_hunched.body: Back arched up, belly tucked, legs drawn under the body

stand_hind.body: Upright on the hind legs only, forelegs free or folded against the chest

forepaws_up.body: Hind feet on the ground, forepaws resting on something raised: a person, a counter, a ledge, a sill, a platform

sit.body: Rump on the ground, hind legs folded evenly with the hocks flat beside the body, forelegs vertical, spine upright

sit_hip.body: Sitting rolled onto one hip, the upper hind leg kicked out sideways

sit_pretty.body: Balanced on the haunches with the spine vertical and both forelegs lifted and folded at the wrists

sit_prop.body: Sitting with the forepaws resting on a person's lap or a low ledge

sit_slump.body: Sitting with the spine sagging and the head sinking, eyes heavy

platz.body: Chest and elbows down, forelegs straight ahead and parallel, hind legs folded square underneath with the hocks loaded to spring, head up

down_sphinx.body: Chest down, forelegs ahead, hind legs folded but not loaded; weight settled, head up or chin on the forepaws

down_hip.body: Chest down at the front, hindquarters rolled onto one hip with both hind legs to one side

sploot_half.body: Chest down, one hind leg folded under, the other stretched straight back with the pad up

sploot.body: Belly flat on the floor, both hind legs stretched straight back with the thighs turned so the pads face up, pelvis flat

loaf.body: Chest down with the forelegs folded back under the chest and the hind legs tucked

crouch_flat.body: Belly at or on the ground, forelegs gathered, hind legs loaded, head low and forward in line with the spine, eyes locked on the target

crouch_spring.body: Hind legs bunched under the body, weight back on the haunches, forequarters light; held for a beat before a leap

cower_flat.body: Body pressed flat, ears pinned, tail tucked against the belly, head low or turned away, often trembling

lateral.body: Lying on one side, legs stretched away from the body, head on the ground

curl.body: Lying curled in a ring, nose tucked to the flank or tail, legs gathered in

dorsal.body: On the back, legs loose in the air, spine curved, head tipped to one side

dorsal_appease.body: Rolled onto the side or back and holding still, upper hind leg lifted to bare the groin, tail tucked, ears back, eyes averted

play_bow.body: Forelegs and chest dropped with elbows down, hindquarters up with hind legs straight, tail up; quick and bouncy, facing a partner

stretch_bow.body: The same shape as play_bow, held slowly with forelegs reaching forward and eyes heavy; after rest, aimed at no one

prayer.body: The same shape as play_bow, held still with no wag; a sign of belly pain

head_rest.body: Lying with the chin on something raised: a bed's edge, a step, a person's foot

walk.body: Four-beat gait: left hind, left fore, right hind, right fore; two or three feet always down

amble.body: Fast four-beat lateral walk, between walk and pace

pace.body: Two-beat gait, both legs on one side moving together, body rolling side to side

trot.body: Two-beat diagonal gait, opposite fore and hind moving together

trot_flying.body: Trot with a moment where all four feet are off the ground

crab.body: Trot with the body angled to the line of travel so the hind feet pass beside the forefeet

canter.body: Three-beat gait: one hind, then the diagonal pair, then the leading fore, then a suspension

gallop_transverse.body: Four-beat run with fore and hind leads on the same side, one suspension

gallop_rotary.body: Four-beat run with footfalls circling the body; sighthounds add a second suspension with the body fully stretched

bound.body: Both hind legs push off together, forelegs land close together; speed bursts, deep snow

pronk.body: Stiff-legged bouncing, all four feet leaving and landing together

prance.body: High-stepping bouncy trot, head and tail high

stalk.body: Slow low walk, head forward in line with the spine, gaze locked, feet placed silently, freezing mid-step

slink.body: Low quick walk, body lowered, tail tucked, ears back, eyes averted

meander.body: Slow wandering walk with frequent stops and turns, head dropping to sniff

zoomies.body: Bursts of fast running in loops and figure-eights with sharp turns, rump tucked low under the body

chase.body: Running at a moving target, steering to cut it off rather than follow it

flee.body: Running away fast, tail tucked, ears back, glancing back

side_step.body: Moving sideways, legs stepping or crossing laterally

pivot_rear.body: Forefeet nearly in place while the hind end swings around them

pivot_front.body: Hind feet nearly in place while the front swings around them

u_turn.body: Fast reversal around the forelegs, rear swinging out

jump_long.body: Hind legs push off together, forelegs reach, forefeet land first; distance over height

jump_vertical.body: Spring straight up from all fours or from the hind legs

jump_over.body: Approach, gather, take off, clear the obstacle, land

jump_onto.body: Spring onto something higher: bed, couch, car, wall

jump_down.body: Drop from a height, forelegs absorbing the landing

leap_catch.body: Leap and twist to meet a thrown object with the mouth

pounce.body: Arcing leap up and forward, forefeet landing first to pin the target

climb.body: Scrabbling up a steep slope or obstacle with all four feet

descend.body: Going down a slope with weight held back over the hind legs

stairs_up.body: Climbing steps, hind legs alternating or hopping together

stairs_down.body: Going down steps, forelegs reaching, sometimes rushing

crawl.body: Moving forward with the belly on the ground, legs pulling and pushing

swim.body: Body near horizontal, head above water, forelegs paddling in a trot pattern, hind legs pushing, tail steering

wade.body: Walking through shallow water with high steps

water_entry.body: Launching into water from a bank or dock

plow.body: Pushing the face through snow or leaves while moving forward

pull.body: Leaning into the collar or harness, forelegs reaching, head low, scrabbling forward

pull_load.body: Steady trot or lope against a load in a harness

skid_stop.body: Hard braking with forelegs braced, sliding on loose ground

slip.body: A foot loses grip and the leg splays; recovered by scrabbling

stumble.body: A foot catches; a quick catch step restores balance

fall.body: Balance lost to the ground: onto the side, forward over the shoulder, or backward

collide.body: Running into an obstacle or another dog and bouncing off

bad_landing.body: Legs buckle on landing from a jump, often rolling through

scramble_up.body: Getting the feet back fast after a fall, often followed by shake_off_dry

orient.body: Head, then ears, then body turn toward a stimulus and hold

watch_moving.body: Head and eyes follow a moving thing

head_tilt.body: Head tipped to one side and held, often while listening to speech or an odd sound

head_shake.body: Fast side-to-side shake of the head, ears flapping

head_turn_away.body: Head turned away from a person or dog while the body stays

nudge.body: Bumping a hand, arm or object with the closed nose

muzzle_punch.body: Sharp bump with the closed muzzle

nose_push.body: Pushing blanket, soil or leaves over something with the nose

chin_rest.body: Chin placed on a lap, knee, hand or another dog's back, and held there

sniff_air.body: Head up, nostrils working in short bursts, turning into the wind

sniff_ground.body: Head down, nose at the ground, following a trail step by step

sniff_detail.body: Nose held close to one spot or object for a long bout, sometimes licking it

sniff_person.body: Sniffing a person's hands, legs, crotch or shoes

chatter.body: Jaw chattering and foamy saliva after sniffing a urine mark

quarter.body: Running zigzags across the wind to find a scent, narrowing them as the scent gets stronger

indicate.body: A trained final response at the scent source: sit, down, freeze, stare or bark

grab.body: Fast bite that seizes an object or prey

grip_full.body: Object deep in the mouth, back teeth engaged, held steady and calm

hold.body: Object held gently in the front of the mouth without chewing

carry.body: Holding something in the mouth while moving

mouthing.body: Mouth around a hand or arm with little or no pressure

nibble.body: Rapid tiny incisor nibbles on skin, fur or fabric

nip.body: Quick light bite with the front teeth, released at once

air_snap.body: Fast bite that stops short or closes on air; a warning

bite.body: Bite with pressure, held or repeated

shake_kill.body: Gripping an object and shaking it hard side to side

tug.body: Gripping an object and pulling back with the body weight, head shaking, often growling

shred.body: Pinning an object with the forepaws and tearing it apart with the teeth

chew.body: Rhythmic chewing with the side teeth, head tilted, object held by the forepaws

gnaw.body: Scraping a bone with the front teeth

catch_mouth.body: Head tracks a tossed item and the jaws close on it

take_gentle.body: Taking food from fingers with the lips and front teeth

release.body: Mouth opens and the object drops or is taken

present.body: Pushing a held object toward a hand

spit.body: Rejecting something from the mouth with tongue and head flicks

pant.body: Mouth open, tongue out, rapid shallow breaths

pant_stress.body: Panting with lip corners pulled far back and the tongue widened at the tip, without heat to explain it

yawn.body: Wide jaw opening, often with a squeak, tongue curled

lip_lick.body: Quick tongue flick over the nose or lips

lick_person.body: Licking a person's face, hands or feet

lick_muzzle.body: Licking the corners of another dog's mouth

lick_object.body: Licking floors, furniture, fabric or the air

blep.body: Tongue tip resting out of the closed mouth

lip_curl.body: Upper lip lifted to bare the front teeth

snarl.body: Lips drawn up and back, nose wrinkled, teeth and gums showing

grin_appease.body: Lips drawn back horizontally showing the front teeth, eyes squinting, body low and wiggly

play_face.body: Mouth open and relaxed, lips loose, tongue soft

mouth_tight.body: Mouth shut tight, lip corners short and pushed forward

lip_smack.body: Jaw smacking or chomping with nothing in the mouth

ears_neutral.body: Ears at the breed's resting position

ears_forward.body: Ear openings turned forward, bases raised

ears_airplane.body: Ears rotated out to the sides and flattened

ears_back_soft.body: Ears drawn slightly back and relaxed

ears_pinned.body: Ears pressed flat against the head

ears_split.body: One ear forward and one back, each tracking a different sound

eyes_soft.body: Lids relaxed, eyes almond-shaped, normal blinking

stare_hard.body: Fixed, unblinking stare with the body still

whale_eye.body: Head turned away while the eyes stay on the target, showing the whites

blink_slow.body: Slow deliberate blinks while looking at someone

gaze_avert.body: Looking away from a person or dog

gaze_alternate.body: Looking at an object, then at a person, then back

gaze_follow.body: Looking where a person points or looks

eye_contact.body: Looking at a person's face and holding it

brow_raise.body: Inner brows raised so the eyes look bigger

tail_flag.body: Tail high and stiff, sometimes with small fast wags

tail_tucked.body: Tail clamped between the hind legs against the belly

tail_level.body: Tail held straight out behind and still

wag_wiggle.body: Wag that swings the whole rear and curves the body

wag_low_fast.body: Quick small wags with the tail low

wag_bias.body: Wags swinging more to the dog's right toward something it likes, more to its left when wary (Quaranta et al., 2007)

tail_rudder.body: Tail swings to counterbalance in turns, jumps and swimming

hackles.body: Hair raised over the shoulders, along the back, or both

shake_off.body: Body twists rapidly from head to tail to throw off water

shake_off_dry.body: The same shake when dry, after tension, handling or a fall

tremble.body: Fine shaking from cold, fear, pain or excitement

skin_twitch.body: Skin over the back ripples where it was touched or bitten

body_stiff.body: Muscles locked, movement jerky or stopped

turn_away.body: Presenting the side or back to a person or dog

paw_at.body: Raising a foreleg to touch or scrape at a person

give_paw.body: Placing a forepaw in an offered hand

high_five.body: Forepaw raised to meet a raised hand

wave.body: Forepaw raised and lowered in the air

paw_bat.body: Swatting an object or another dog with a forepaw

paw_pin.body: Holding an object down with one or both forepaws

scrape_surface.body: Scratching at a door, floor or crate with the forepaws

dig.body: Forepaws taking turns scooping earth back between the hind legs

dig_bed.body: Scratching and pushing bedding into a pile before lying down

reach_paw.body: Foreleg stretched under furniture or into a gap to hook something out

paw_face.body: A forepaw drawn over the muzzle or eyes

box.body: Rearing up and batting at another dog with the forelegs

hug.body: Forelegs wrapped around a person's leg or arm

mount.body: Forelegs clasping another dog, a leg or an object, pelvis thrusting

scratch_self.body: Fast hind-leg scratching at the neck, ear or flank

scratch_reflex.body: A hind leg kicks in rhythm while a person scratches the belly or flank

ground_scratch.body: Scraping the ground with the hind feet, sometimes the forefeet too, after eliminating

stretch_rear.body: Body pulled forward on straight forelegs, hind legs stretched back together or one at a time

scoot.body: Dragging the rump along the ground, pulled by the forelegs

back_rub.body: Lying on the back and wriggling side to side

scent_roll.body: Shoulder, then neck and back, ground into a smelly spot

face_rub.body: Rubbing the face along a rug or grass, forepaws pushing the head along

body_rub.body: Rubbing the side along furniture or a person

lean.body: Resting body weight against a person's legs

body_slam.body: Running into another dog with a hip or shoulder in play

pin_partner.body: Holding a playmate down with the forelegs or the body

split.body: Walking into the gap between two dogs or people who are close together

tail_chase.body: Spinning while trying to catch its own tail

fly_snap.body: Snapping at the air as if at flies that aren't there

bark_alert.body: Sharp barks in a series at a stimulus, mid to low pitch, body forward

bark_demand.body: Single or spaced barks at a person, pausing to check the result

bark_play.body: Higher, bouncy barks during play, often with a play bow

bark_frustrated.body: Fast, repetitive, high barking at a barrier or something out of reach

bay.body: Long, deep, drawn-out bark-howl while trailing

howl.body: Long rising and falling tone with the head raised

whine.body: High nasal sound, mouth closed or barely open

yelp.body: Sudden sharp high cry; in play it means "too hard"

growl_warn.body: Low rumbling growl, body still, mouth closed or lip curled

growl_play.body: Growling during tug or wrestling, body loose

huff.body: Short hard breath out through the nose

groan.body: Low contented moan while settling or being rubbed

play_sneeze.body: Short sneeze during play, used as a signal

dream_noise.body: Muffled barks, yips or whimpers during sleep

eat_gulp.body: Head down in the bowl, fast jaw action, little chewing

eat_carry.body: Taking food from the bowl and carrying it off to eat elsewhere

drink.body: Tongue curls back to scoop water into the mouth, splashing

graze.body: Nibbling or ripping grass with the front teeth

scavenge.body: Nose to the ground, then a sudden grab and swallow while walking

cache.body: Dig, drop the item, nose_push soil or blanket over it

pica.body: Eating things that aren't food: socks, stones, sticks

urinate_squat.body: Hindquarters lowered, hind legs spread and bent, tail up

urinate_leg.body: One hind leg raised high, aimed at something vertical

urinate_tripod.body: Half squat with one hind leg partly raised

urinate_handstand.body: Weight on the forelegs, hind end walked up a wall

urinate_appease.body: Leaking urine while low, rolled over or greeting

defecate.body: Back arched, hind legs drawn forward under the body, tail up; sometimes walking while going

site_circle.body: Circling and sniffing to pick the spot before defecating

lick_self.body: Licking paws, legs, flanks or genitals

nibble_self.body: Front-teeth nibbling at its own coat or skin

sunbathe.body: Lying in a patch of sun, belly or side exposed

seek_cool.body: Lying on tile or in shade, digging a cool pit, lying in water, splooting

seek_warm.body: Curling tight, burrowing under blankets, pressing against a warm body

paw_lift_cold.body: Lifting the feet off cold ground in turn

drowsy.body: Eyes half closed, head sinking and jerking back up

sleep.body: Any lying posture held with eyes closed and slow breathing

rem.body: Paws paddling, whiskers and eyelids twitching, muffled noises

startle_wake.body: Sudden jerk awake, head up, orienting

sneeze.body: Head jerks down with an explosive sneeze

reverse_sneeze.body: Standing still, neck stretched, rapid noisy honking breaths in

cough.body: Short hard coughs, sometimes ending in a gag

retch.body: Belly heaving, neck stretched, mouth open

vomit.body: Strong belly heaves, head low, stomach contents brought up

regurgitate.body: Food comes back up without heaving

gas_startle.body: Passing gas, then turning to look at its own rear

heat_stress.body: Heavy panting with a widened tongue, lying flat, thick drool, slowing down

cold_stress.body: Hunched, tail tucked, shivering, lifting the feet

fatigue.body: Head carried lower, paces instead of trotting, shorter bursts, lies down more

limp_fore.body: Head bobs up as the sore foreleg lands

limp_hind.body: Hip on the sore side hikes up, shorter stride

three_leg.body: Standing or hopping with one leg held up

stiff_rise.body: Slow rise after rest, front end first, hind end lagging

pace_restless.body: Walking back and forth along the same path, unable to settle

startle.body: Whole-body flinch or jump away from a sudden sound or touch

flag_tail.body: In standing heat the bitch plants her hind legs, holds her tail to one side and stands still when touched at the rump

vulva_wink.body: The vulva lifts and tightens in rhythm when the area is sniffed or touched

erect.body: The penis swells and extends from the sheath

tie.body: After mounting the pair stay locked at the genitals; the male steps a hind leg over and they stand rump to rump for minutes, up to half an hour

court_lick.body: Licking a bitch's vulva and ears and nudging her flank and neck

seclude.body: Withdrawing to a dark, enclosed spot and staying there: before whelping, when ill, when dying

strain.body: Bearing down: flanks and belly tighten in waves, tail raised, lying on the side or squatting

clean_newborn.body: Tearing the membrane off a newborn with the front teeth, chewing through the cord, then licking the pup hard until it squeals and breathes

nurse.body: Lying on one side, or later standing, holding still with the belly exposed while pups feed

stimulate_pup.body: Licking a pup's belly and rear until it urinates and defecates, and swallowing the result

root.body: A newborn swings its head side to side and pushes forward along the dam's belly with its nose until it meets a teat

suckle.body: Tongue cupped around a teat, sucking in rhythm; adults do the same to a blanket, a toy or their own flank

knead.body: Forepaws pushing in turn into the dam's belly while suckling; adults do it to bedding

pup_cry.body: High repeated squeaks from a pup that is cold, hungry or out of the nest

scruff_hold.body: Gripping the loose skin at the back of another dog's neck and holding or shaking it

drive_in.body: Pushing forward into an opponent while gripping, to knock it off its feet

harry.body: Rushing in to bite and springing back out of reach, again and again, at something bigger or dangerous

circle_opponent.body: Stiff-legged circling shoulder to shoulder, each dog watching for an opening

feint.body: Starting a lunge and stopping short to make the other react

toss.body: Flinging a toy or small prey into the air with a jerk of the head, then chasing or catching it

block.body: Standing or lying across a doorway or path so another can't pass

guard_part.body: Holding a sore part still: turning the whole body instead of the neck, keeping weight off a leg, flinching or snapping when the spot is touched

knuckle.body: A paw set down on its upper surface, toes dragging or scuffing

stagger.body: Swaying, wide-legged walk with legs crossing and drifting to one side

circle_one_way.body: Walking in tight circles in one direction only, often with the head tilted

head_press.body: Pressing the top of the head against a wall or corner and holding it there

collapse.body: The legs give way and the dog goes down in a heap

seizure.body: Falls on its side, body rigid, then legs paddling, jaw champing, drooling, sometimes voiding

labored_breath.body: Belly heaving, elbows turned out, neck stretched, mouth open at rest

leak.body: Urine or feces passed with no posture, while lying, asleep or walking

belch.body: Air released up from the stomach, often after eating fast

gland_release.body: A sudden sharp-smelling release from the anal sacs when badly frightened or very excited

agonal_gasp.body: Slow, deep, open-mouthed gasps with long pauses between them, at the end of life

go_limp.body: All muscle tone lets go: the body slackens, the jaw falls open, bladder and bowel release

snore.body: Rattling or whistling breath in sleep, sometimes with a pause and a snort

rumble.body: Low, steady, contented growl while being rubbed or leaning on someone

grunt.body: Short low grunt on effort, on lying down, or from pups when content

boof.body: Soft closed-mouth bark that puffs the cheeks

tail_thump.body: Tail beating the floor while lying down as someone approaches or speaks

groom_dog.body: Licking and nibbling another dog's ears, eyes, face or neck

rump_present.body: Turning and backing the hindquarters into a person or dog, often for a scratch

paw_over.body: Laying a foreleg across another dog's shoulders or back

self_handicap.body: Lying down, rolling over or softening its bites to play at a smaller or weaker partner's level

vigil.body: Waiting at a door, gate or window for someone to return, lying or sitting, ears turning to every sound

patrol.body: Walking the edge of its space on a regular route, sniffing and marking

fence_run.body: Running back and forth along a fence or window, barking at what is on the other side

hoard.body: Collecting objects into its bed or a chosen spot

predatory.breed: Coppinger's breed differences sit here. Herders exaggerate eye, stalk and chase and stop before the bite; heelers stop at the nip; retrievers exaggerate grab and carry with a soft mouth; pointers freeze at eye as stand_point; terriers exaggerate the kill shake and dig; sighthounds the chase; livestock guardians run almost none of it

steps.text: quarter or sniff_detail at the area
drop at the feet or keep_away
crouch_flat with stare_hard to hold it (eye)

herd_gather.trigger: stock, or people and dogs moving apart
herd_gather.breed: border collies: wide, heavy eye; heelers: close, nipping heels

steps.text: move between the handler and the stranger
bite on cue or when pressed
face them and bark without touching

greet_human.breed: the Labrador: grab and carry an object first

steps.text: play_bow or move off; tense greetings go to stand_freeze or stand_over
play_bow, play_face, pronk, play_sneeze, paw_bat, then dart off and look back
one dog runs and the other chases, then they swap; the stronger dog handicaps itself
box, mouthing at the neck and face, body_slam, pin_partner, roll, swap who's on top
head_turn_away, lip_lick, yawn, sniff the ground, slow down, sit or lie down, curve away, split

escalate.breed: Shepherd's "ladder of aggression"; a dog that skips steps has usually been punished for the early ones

guard_resource.trigger: someone nears food or a toy

steps.text: urinate_leg or urinate_squat on the spot

mark.trigger: another dog's mark, a new place

steps.text: present to the person, often keeping it
following a person from room to room, settling wherever they stop
glance back at the handler during a walk or play, then carry on
lying pressed against a person or dog
gently gripping another dog's muzzle, then letting go
head out the window, nose working, ears flapping
shake_off on the bank, then scent_roll or zoomies
scrape_surface or dig at the exit
court_lick, play_bow, chin_rest on her back, paw_over
pounce or chase as the partner passes
block between it and the flock

down.strict: platz, from motion by the drop
down.notes: the dog's pick shows its state: sploot when hot, platz when keyed up

stand.strict: kick-back stand with no forward step

stay.accepts_text: the current state, held until released

wait.accepts_text: pause in place, expecting the next cue

come.strict: straight fast approach ending in a front sit

front.accepts_text: sit facing the handler, centered and close

heel.accepts_text: walk or trot at the handler's left with the shoulder at the leg, matching pace and turns; sit when the handler stops

finish.accepts_text: front to heel, behind the handler or flipping in

middle.accepts_text: stand or walk between the handler's legs, facing forward

weave.accepts_text: figure-eight through the handler's legs as they walk
weave.notes: the Malinois offers this unasked: handler-position control, as in herding

around.accepts_text: circle the handler and come back

leave_it.accepts_text: disengage from the target and orient to the handler

get.notes: the Labrador: almost any item, delivered near the handler, not to hand

mark.accepts_text: track the fall with head and eyes

back.accepts_text: gallop straight away for a blind retrieve

over.accepts_text: run left or right at a right angle

send_away.accepts_text: gallop straight away, then down on cue

place.accepts_text: go to the mat, then any down

settle.accepts_text: down_hip, lateral or curl, staying calm

kennel.accepts_text: go into the crate and lie down

off.accepts_text: all four feet on the floor

up.accepts_text: forepaws_up on the indicated person or surface

load.accepts_text: jump_onto into the car or onto the table

spin.accepts_text: spin one way or the other

touch.accepts_text: nose touch to the palm or a target

chin.accepts_text: chin_rest on the hand or knee

roll_over.accepts_text: down → lateral → dorsal → lateral on the far side → down

play_dead.accepts_text: drop to lateral and go limp

watch.accepts_text: orient and stare_hard at the indicated person, barking if they move

steady.accepts_text: stop and hold still while birds flush or shots go off

stop.accepts_text: stop and sit on the spot, facing the handler

stop_herding.accepts_text: stop moving, holding eye on the stock

line_out.accepts_text: lead dog stands out front keeping the line tight

honor.accepts_text: stop and hold still on seeing another dog on point

flush.accepts_text: rush in to put the birds up

drive.accepts_text: push the stock away from the handler

shed.accepts_text: hold two groups of stock apart

pen.accepts_text: push the stock into a pen and hold them there

brace.accepts_text: stand stiff so the handler can lean on the shoulders

press.accepts_text: nose_push or paw_at a button, door or drawer

alert_sound.accepts_text: nudge the handler and lead them to a doorbell, alarm or name call

refuse_unsafe.accepts_text: disobey a cue that would put the handler in danger, such as "forward" into traffic
refuse_unsafe.notes: guide dogs; trainers call it intelligent disobedience

edges.how: tuck: hind feet step forward under the body and the rump drops
rock-back: rump drops straight back, forefeet slide back
kick-back: hind legs push back and straighten, forefeet stay
step-up: forelegs walk forward as the rump lifts
drop: all four legs fold at once, landing square
fold-back: forelegs reach forward and the chest lowers, then the rear folds
slide: forelegs walk or slide forward until the chest is down, rump stays
push-up: forelegs push the chest up, rump stays
